newsitem.title: FRANCE: French centre-right would win slim majority - poll.
newsitem.headline: French centre-right would win slim majority - poll.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of voters' intentions ahead of the May 25/June 1 parliamentary election.

The telephone poll of 1,046 adults aged 18 and over was conducted by CSA on April 28 and 29 for France 3 television, French daily Le Parisien, France Inter and France Info radio and made public on Tuesday:
CSA said 32 percent of those surveyed would abstain or spoil their vote.
The poll also showed that slightly more voters approved of the way Socialist Party leader Lionel Jospin has run his campaign so far compared with Prime Minister Alain Juppe.
Some 38 percent said Jospin was either excellent or good while 34 percent thought the same of Juppe. Fifty percent thought Jospin was either mediocre or bad, while Juppe scored 53 percent.
